critic.fix_suggestion: Duplicate the existing window row primitive along the fuselage to create two distinct rows. Offset the new row vertically by 15% of the total fuselage height to represent the upper deck, and adjust the spacing of both rows so that windows are omitted or clustered around door locations (repositioning them to a variable interval rather than uniform).

discrepancies.observed: A single continuous line of small dots along the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Two distinct rows of windows (main deck and upper deck).

discrepancies.observed: Windows are missing from the forward 'hump' section.
discrepancies.reference: A prominent row of windows follows the curve of the upper deck hump.

discrepancies.observed: No visible door frames or outlines on the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Clearly defined rectangular door outlines with recessed frames.

discrepancies.observed: Uniformly spaced dots across the entire length.
discrepancies.reference: Variable spacing and grouping of windows, especially near doors.
